What’s in Axalta Coating Systems LTD.HARES (NYSE:AXTA) After Decline in Shorted Shares?
 Michele Cranor
The stock of Axalta Coating Systems LTD.HARES (NYSE:AXTA) registered a decrease of 17.22% in short interest. AXTA’s total short interest was 7.71 million shares in September as published by FINRA. Its down 17.22% from 9.31M shares, reported previously. With 2.19 million shares average volume, it will take short sellers 4 days to cover their AXTA’s short positions. The short interest to Axalta Coating Systems LTD.HARES’s float is 3.57%.
The stock decreased 0.29% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $30.5. About 1.31M shares traded. Axalta Coating Systems Ltd. (NYSE:AXTA) has risen 2.73% uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.84% the S&P500.
Axalta Coating Systems Ltd., through its subsidiaries, makes, markets, and distributes coatings primarily for the transportation industry. The company has market cap of $7.34 billion. It operates through two divisions, Performance Coatings and Transportation Coatings. It has a 54.56 P/E ratio. The Performance Coatings segment offers various water and solvent borne products and systems that are used to refinish damaged vehicles for independent body shops, multi-shop operators, and original equipment maker dealership body shops.
